input_coefficients: Fraction/QQ only; no Float, approximation, evalf, or oracle call in the MoonBit kernel

cases.name: probe dependent irrational diagonal
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: probe nullified product fibre
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x2 x2) (* (- 2))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: probe four variable shared product contradiction
cases.hand_argument: The identical product cannot be zero and positive.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(declare-fun x3 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* (- 1) x0 x3) (* (- 1) x1 x2) (* 1 x1 x3)) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* (- 1) x0 x3) (* (- 1) x1 x2) (* 1 x1 x3)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: bilinear nonzero product at zero factor
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: bilinear nullification with irrational other coordinate
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 2))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: bilinear negative product of positives
cases.hand_argument: A product of positive reals is positive, not -1.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* 1)) 0) (and (> (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: bilinear negative branch Boolean alternative
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (or (< (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (< (+ (* 1 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: dependent irrational product exact
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* (- 2))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: dependent irrational product disequality
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* (- 2))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: conjugate roots exhaustive alternatives
cases.hand_argument: The pair x=y=sqrt(2) satisfies the first alternative.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 2))) 0) (or (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* 1 x1)) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: conjugate roots neither alternative
cases.hand_argument: Equal squares imply (x-y)*(x+y)=0 in a field.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (distinct (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x0) (* 1 x1)) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: square root over negative parent
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1 x1)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* 1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: repeated section excludes zero root
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1 x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: nested positive fourth root
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1 x1)) 0) (and (> (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x1)) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: circle rational external threshold
cases.hand_argument: x*x<=1 on the circle, so x cannot exceed 3/2.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x0) (* (/ (- 3) 2))) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: circle rational endpoint section
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: circle rational endpoint rejects off axis
cases.hand_argument: x=1 on this circle forces y=0.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x1)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: annulus rational open bounds
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (< (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (/ (- 1) 4))) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: incompatible concentric open bounds
cases.hand_argument: The same squared radius cannot be less than 1 and greater than 4.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (< (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 4))) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: CNF nonlinear disjunction excludes both branches
cases.hand_argument: The first disjunction contradicts the two disequalities.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (or (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0)) (and (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: CNF nonlinear surviving irrational branch
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (or (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0)) (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: CNF separate nonlinear positive conflicts
cases.hand_argument: Both alternatives contradict the asserted strict positives.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (or (<= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (<= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0)) (and (> (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (> (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: CNF exactly one nonlinear boundary
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (or (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0)) (or (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: CNF both nonlinear boundaries forbidden
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (or (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0)) (and (or (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0)) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: negated nonlinear conjunction surviving branch
cases.hand_argument: x=1,y=0 makes p=0 and q nonzero.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(assert (and (not (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 1))) 0))) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 1))) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: trilinear graph at nullified first factor
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* (- 1) x2)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x2) (* (- 1))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: trilinear graph irrational nullification
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* (- 1) x2)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x2)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x1 x1) (* (- 2))) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: dependent three coordinate irrational diagonal
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x1) (* 1 x2)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x2 x2) (* (- 2))) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: dependent three coordinate inconsistent square
cases.hand_argument: All coordinates equal x, whose square is 2.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x0) (* 1 x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* (- 1) x1) (* 1 x2)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x2 x2) (* (- 2))) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: three squares zero with nonzero coordinate alternative
cases.hand_argument: A sum of real squares is zero only when all coordinates vanish.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* 1 x2 x2)) 0) (or (distinct (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (or (distinct (+ (* 1 x1)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x2)) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: three coordinate sphere diagonal plane
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)

(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 1 x1 x1) (* 1 x2 x2) (* (- 2))) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x2)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: three products nullified middle factor
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1 x2)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* (- 1))) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: three products require middle factor nonzero
cases.hand_argument: y nonzero forces x=z=0, contradicting x*z=1.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1 x2)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* (- 1))) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x1)) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: four variable nullified factor with dependent irrational pair
cases.smt2:

(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(declare-fun x3 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* (- 1) x0 x3) (* (- 1) x1 x2) (* 1 x1 x3)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x2 x2) (* (- 2))) 0) (= (+ (* (- 1) x2) (* 1 x3)) 0)))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: four variable nonzero product with zero factor

(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(declare-fun x3 () Real)
(assert (and (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* (- 1) x0 x3) (* (- 1) x1 x2) (* 1 x1 x3)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

cases.name: four variable nonzero product and both factors

(declare-fun x3 () Real)
(assert (and (distinct (+ (* 1 x0 x2) (* (- 1) x0 x3) (* (- 1) x1 x2) (* 1 x1 x3)) 0) (and (distinct (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x2) (* (- 1) x3)) 0))))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)

(declare-fun x0 () Real)

(declare-fun x2 () Real)

(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x1) (* 1 x2 x3) (* (- 1))) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x0)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x2)) 0))))

(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0) (* (- 1) x1)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x1) (* (- 1) x2)) 0) (and (= (+ (* 1 x2) (* (- 1) x3)) 0) (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* (- 2))) 0)))))

cases.name: four weighted squares zero excludes last coordinate
cases.hand_argument: Every positive weighted square must vanish.
cases.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(declare-fun x0 () Real)
(declare-fun x1 () Real)
(declare-fun x2 () Real)
(declare-fun x3 () Real)
(assert (and (= (+ (* 1 x0 x0) (* 2 x1 x1) (* 3 x2 x2) (* (/ 1 2) x3 x3)) 0) (distinct (+ (* 1 x3)) 0)))
(check-sat-using qfnra-nlsat)
